setup: source .venv/bin/activate && alembic upgrade head || echo '⚠️  Shared DB not reachable; run docker compose up -d db in the main checkout'

branchName.instructions: Use the format <type>/<short-slug>, where type is feat, fix, chore, or docs. Example: feat/evidence-upload.

commitMessage.instructions: Follow Conventional Commits. Scope is the module name: review-core, platform, api, web, scenarios, etc. Example: feat(review-core): add finding reopen reason.

pullRequest.instructions: Title follows Conventional Commits. Body has sections: ## Why, ## Changes, ## Testing. For changes to the domain model, permissions, concurrency, migrations or new external dependencies, the Why section also covers the problem, the approach and the alternatives considered.

check-backend.command: source .venv/bin/activate && ruff check . && mypy && python scripts/check_architecture.py && python scripts/check_openapi.py

check-frontend.command: cd web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test

test-browser.command: cd web && EASYAUDIT_WEB_PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); print(s.getsockname()[1])') npm run test:browser

check-all.command: source .venv/bin/activate && ruff check . && mypy && python scripts/check_architecture.py && python scripts/check_openapi.py && EASYAUDIT_RUN_POSTGRES_TESTS=1 pytest && cd web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
